items.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
items.summary: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.

items.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
items.summary: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

items.title: AI leaders are actually asking to slow AI down
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei wrote a 3,800-word essay arguing that AI capabilities are moving too fast for safety work to keep up. Sam Altman, Elon Musk and DeepMind’s Demis Hassabis basically agree .

items.title: OpenAI isn’t going public this year
items.summary: despite confidentially filing for an IPO, Sam Altman says 2026 would be an “ ill-advised ” time to actually do it. OpenAI had reportedly been aiming for Q3/Q4 this year, but Altman now says “we’ve got a lot of stuff to do.”
